sentences.text:
Heard Sri Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Akhilesh Kumar Shukla,
learned counsel for opposite party no.2, Sri Birendra Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the State and perused the records.
2. Office to trace out the Vakalatnama of Sri Akhilesh Kumar Shukla and place it on record.

3. The facts of the case are that a first information report was lodged on 24.08.2023 against the applicants by Ajay Singh, opposite party no.2 on the basis of an application under Section 156(3)
Cr.P.C. alleging therein that on 01.08.2023 at about 06:15 am, his minor daughter aged about 7 Vijay And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168150334/
1 years had gone to ease herself but did not return till late on which, his wife Pooja started searching her and then found her in a totally disturbed condition with her torn clothes.

entities.text: Vijay And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She came home quite terrified on which his wife asked his daughter to which she stated that she was going in front of the house accused Pitam who forcibly pulled her in his house and throw her on the floor and inserted his finger in her private parts to which she shouted and then he left her.

On hearing about the incident, his wife Smt. Pooja went to the house of Pitam along with him where accused Vijay, Pitam and Gitam throw his wife on the floor and tore her clothes and abused her and enraged her modesty.
She started shouting, on hearing which, Raju and other persons came there and saved her.
He then took his wife to the police station for lodging of the report but the police did not lodge the report.
The matter was investigated and subsequently, a final report was submitted by the police which is numbered as Final Report No.78 of 2023 dated 11.09.2023.
A recommendation under Section 182 Cr.PC. was also done in the same.

A protest petition to the same was filed by the informant, on which, the trial court subsequently summoned the accused Pitam for offences under section 376,
323 IPC and Section of the POCSO Act and accused Vijay and Gitam for offences under Section 354 kha, 323, 504, 506 IPC.
The applicants are thus before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is argued that the investigating agency found the implication of the applicants to be false and thus submitted a final report in the matter.

It is submitted that during the pendency of the proceedings before the trial court, the parties have entered into a compromise and the compromise deed had been prepared, which was filed before the court concerned.

Both the victims have stated therein that no such incident took place as stated in the first information report, copy of the said compromise has been placed before the court which is annexed as Annexure 10 to the affidavit.
It is submitted that looking to the same, the present application be allowed and the proceedings against the applicants be quashed.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for quashing and submitted that the proceedings of the present case cannot be quashed on the basis of compromise since the offences are non-compoundable in nature.
It is submitted that insofar as accused Pitam is concerned, there are specific allegations of his involvement in the present matter and also the victim is aged about seven years.

It is submitted that insofar as the other two accused persons are concerned, the allegations against them are also serious in nature and also of enraging the modesty of the mother of the victim,
when she went to make a complaint about the incident.

It is submitted that looking to the facts of the case and the judgment of this Court in the case of Sanjeev Kumar vs. State of UP and 3 others passed in Application u/s482 Cr.P.C. No.9169 of 2024 decided on 02.04.2024, the proceedings of the present case cannot be quashed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. After having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the victim who is stated to have been sexually assaulted, is aged about 7 years.
There is specific allegation against the applicant no.2 Pitam @ Pritam of assaulting her.

Insofar as the other two applicants are concerned, there are specific allegations against them enraging the modesty of the mother of the victim, when she went to make a complaint about the incident with her daughter.
They were joined by accused Pitam @ Pritam at that time also.
The offences are non-compoundable in nature.
The offences are serious and grievous in nature.

Insofar as Pitam @ Pritam is concerned,
Vijay And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168150334/
2 he has been summoned under Special statute also.

entities.text: Vijay And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The same cannot be compounded.
This court in the case of Sanjeev Kumar (supra) has held that a case under the special statute cannot be quashed.
Further, it has been held that the nature and gravity of offence is also to be looked into.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature and gravity of the offence, no ground for interference is made out.
The present application thus lacks merit and is rejected.
